propositions: Advisory finding text is never enumerated on Gerrit changes; only the count of advisory findings is published in the review message body.

The adapter._summarize PASS branch renders only len(verdict['advisory']) as a count and never itemizes finding details, while the 'finding' branch itemizes blocking findings only and drops advisory text.

Advisory findings must be enumerable in the review message body on both PASS and BLOCK paths, and additionally posted as inline comments when their location anchors to a real file path in the revision.
Finding location information is discarded at adapter._translate_findings and never propagates to the Gerrit layer, preventing any per-file or per-line anchoring of comments.
On comment-posting failure the vote must still land with an explicit notice in the message body naming the durable code_review artifact as the full record, never silently omitting advisories.
